changes.collection: Scoped linked-SKU exclusion stays in SQL. UNION ALL orders by latest same-tenant update descending, id descending, and legacy before SKU at a tie, then applies LIMIT/OFFSET. Cache entries hold only count and requested-page keys; a separate version/scoped count cache supports subsequent pages.
changes.csv: Legacy-first and standalone-SKU second ordering is unchanged. Both inputs use ordered seek batches of at most 500 models with related prefetches. Rows and CSV cells are generated one at a time into the existing HttpResponse CSV writer.

mysql_root_verification.page_latency_conclusion: This synthetic sample establishes bounded returned/cached keys, not a stable page latency improvement.

scope_coverage: cross-tenant generated relation ignored for sort and fields
filtered-out legacy relation does not suppress matching SKU

measurement_limits: SQLite checks establish semantics and bounded materialized rows, not MySQL index choice or timing.

Paired historical/current MySQL API measurements are in product-detail-mysql-evidence.json; the root agent temporarily switched the local URLPattern callback and compared response bytes. No stable page latency gain is claimed.
CSV remains a buffered HttpResponse: output memory is proportional to CSV bytes. This is not a streaming HTTP export.
No production rows, production writes, migration, schema change, or deployment performed.
